_comment: Manual, reviewed corrections keyed by Wikidata QID. Every entry MUST include a human reason, a source URL, and reviewed:true. Used by resolve-districts (birthplaceDistrict) and to attach VERIFIED native place (nativePlace/nativeDistrict). Never add unexplained overrides; never fabricate native place.

Q234567.reason: Native place explicitly stated in cited biography.

Q21004841.reason: Wikidata has no place of birth (P19). The Wikipedia biography infobox gives birthplace as Reddipalayam, Tamil Nadu; the linked Reddipalayam article states it is a village in Ariyalur district.
